verdict.rationale: Fidelity offers 409A valuations as part of its Growth plan and markets them as faster/more accurate, but its own docs state these are fulfilled via third-party 409A valuation providers rather than generated automatically in-platform from live cap table data (docs-16, docs-28, docs-32). There's no evidence of automatic generation tied to live cap table changes or scheduled/recurring refresh cadence. Missing for 10: proof of automated in-platform generation directly from cap table data, evidence of scheduled/recurring refresh workflow, and confirmation of 'audit-ready' output format beyond third-party report delivery.
